method: All 1651 frames decoded and differenced; all 32 boundaries inspected on consecutive frames, eight blur spans inspected frame by frame; nine overview sheets cover the entire video. Speech cues from cached ElevenLabs Scribe word timestamps, which are approximate and independent of the measured frame boundaries. Last below word end is overextended by ASR; do not use its 66.0 timestamp as a precise speech endpoint.
boundary_convention: Zero-based frame index. Hard cut: first incoming frame. Blur: first incoming-image frame; effect starts one frame earlier and mostly resolves about five frames later. End frame exclusive.
